rule: Always compare and retain the exact native golden first. A separate bounded-profile result never changes an exact-native mismatch into a native pass. No stderr normalization, warning stripping, diagnostic deletion, or automatic baseline regeneration.
warningPolicy: Native stderr remains raw. Every bounded product row forbids an added GNU obsolescence warning.
